title: fix(onboard): reruns overwrite trusted-proxy authentication
body:
Closes #150083.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: rerunning onboarding silently replaces an existing trusted-proxy Gateway authentication policy.

## User Impact

Existing proxy Gateways keep their auth mode, proxy policy, and password SecretRefs through setup. Explicit auth choices remain available. Selecting Funnel while retaining trusted-proxy auth requires an explicit switch to password mode or leaving Funnel off.

## Why This Change Was Made

Wizard settings carry the config owner's auth modes while CLI auth choices remain token/password. Existing `none` credential inference stays unchanged. The noninteractive writer rejects the same Funnel downgrade, and configure disables incompatible Tailscale exposure before changing the selected bind or auth mode.

Completion and conversational CLI recovery use the existing local-password resolver, including SecretRefs and ambient fallback. Same-host probes and terminal handoff use the required loopback listener, including for custom and tailnet binds. Post-setup health RPCs pin the configured local port so ambient Gateway URL/port overrides cannot redirect derived credentials.

Gateway authorization rules and persistence owners stay unchanged; no SQL or schema changes are introduced. The production delta is +92 lines (176 added / 84 removed); tests and test support are +1006, docs +2. The growth supplies the missing auth-mode and credential handling; duplicate branches were consolidated. No changelog edit: release-note context is retained here.

## Evidence

Production candidate `f2f941971cfd9a45c9d3189ee1189de415764c22` passed [secretless CI 37087800509](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37087800509), including the changed test lanes, types, lint, security and UI/Gateway checks. Independent Codex autoreview completed with no actionable P0–P2 findings. No contributor code was executed on the maintainer host.

Final candidate: `fd14605e68e2594283de42775b8a382513b06b86`. The complete final candidate passed [secretless CI 37089103100](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37089103100). The full candidate passed independent review through P2 before publication.

Production-path credential destination proof used the real health command, real Gateway client and real isolated Gateway process with trusted-proxy password auth. Only surrounding UI/service setup is stubbed. Both callers require the real health command to complete successfully, then inspect the child Gateway's health-request log and an independently listening unrelated socket. Maintainer verification: I downloaded and inspected both exact-head job logs, verified all four records against the passing tests, and accept this scoped credential-destination proof. CI observed:

| Setup flow | Ambient override | Intended health RPCs | Unrelated connections |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Classic | URL + port | 2 | 0 |
| Classic | port only | 2 | 0 |
| Noninteractive | URL + port | 2 | 0 |
| Noninteractive | port only | 2 | 0 |

Exact-head logs: [classic / wizard](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37089103100/job/111105690825) and [noninteractive](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37089103100/job/111105690773). The proof logs contain only synthetic method/count observations, no credentials or private endpoints. This addresses the previous review's final-effect proof request without changing production code.

Measured changed-suite costs on that same run (sum of Vitest's printed test-case milliseconds; not per-file wall time or standalone single-worker measurements):

| Suite | Passing tests | Observed test time |
|---|---:|---:|
| `src/wizard/setup.gateway-config.test.ts` | 18 | >=184 ms; one timing redacted by the log sanitizer |
| `src/wizard/setup.finalize.test.ts` | 51 | 1,290 ms |
| `src/wizard/setup.finalize.trusted-proxy.test.ts` | 5 | 6,022 ms |
| `src/wizard/setup.model-auth.test.ts` | 17 | 44 ms |
| `src/commands/configure.gateway.test.ts` | 24 | 59 ms |
| `src/commands/onboard-helpers.test.ts` | 40 | 76 ms |
| `src/commands/onboard-non-interactive/local/gateway-config.test.ts` | 28 | 51 ms |
| `src/commands/onboard-non-interactive.gateway-health-auth.test.ts` | 7 | 4,259 ms |
| `src/commands/onboard-quickstart-host.test.ts` | 8 | 14 ms |
| `src/system-agent/setup-apply.test.ts` | 51 | 5,739 ms |

The new real-Gateway cases took 4,956 ms (classic) and 3,486 ms (noninteractive), including fixture startup and cleanup inside each test. Historical single-file wrapper wall measurements remain below for comparison; no additional CI reruns were launched merely to obtain standalone timing numbers.

Regression proof in secretless PR CI:

- [37082624524](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37082624524), `c65204e5cd11d`: eight intended assertion failures for both Funnel mode rewrites, configure bind preservation, two omitted-password paths, custom/tailnet probe targets, and `none` credential inference. The earlier configure fixture Promise-contract error was corrected before this run.
- [37085457797](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37085457797), `d7591dd5515ec`: those repairs passed; only the three new conversational CLI recovery credential cases failed.
- [37086873218](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/37086873218), `6173931727ec3`: conversational recovery passed; only three new health-call target-binding assertions failed. Commit `f2f941971cfd9` supplies the existing local-port override at both call sites.

The contributor's [real Gateway/PTY evidence](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/150992#issuecomment-5726418775) covers original config preservation, local password authentication, and terminal handoff. Final classic/noninteractive credential routing additionally has the real-Gateway CI proof above; conversational recovery and the other sibling paths have isolated boundary coverage. No production Gateway or external credentials were used.

Historical test-cost evidence at `c65204e5cd11d`: trusted-proxy finalization's four tests took 6.05 seconds wrapper wall time; Gateway configuration's 18 tests took 5.49 seconds. These were CI single-file invocations with inner parallelism 1, not separate standalone `--maxWorkers=1` measurements.

Credit to @wangmiao0668000666 for the original fix. Their commits are retained, and maintainer follow-ups include their verified human co-author attribution.
